tenderSchedule.title: Construction of CC road in Doddachikkanahalli village limits in Nagamangala Taluk.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tenders should be submitted in two documents through on line
Electronic bid Document I (Technical Bid) shall contain the following documents
A copy of certificate of registration issued by KPWD
Earnest money Deposit(EMD) can also be submitted As per circular No.FD5Expenditure-12/2023 Dt:10.02.2023, in the form e-Bank Guarantee
The Intending bidders / tenderers are advised to visit the site of work and also access the tender documents well in advance
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The TENDER PROCEESING FEE will not be refunded
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka public Portal

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in Karnataka public procurement portal immediately after opening of technical Bid

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, H.C. Division, Yediyur during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events.

The intending bidders should note that, if any of the lands (either in part/parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the Nigama, it shall be the responsibility of the successful bidder to take possession of such land by consent of the owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam and no claims whatsoever relating to non-availability of land would be entertained
Defect liability period will be 3 years from the date of completion of entire work.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka
The Tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc

The application made by the firm / company shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney signed by the board of directors in Karnataka Public portal along with their bid.
The scanned signature of the bidders / authorized representatives of the bidders shall be attached while uploading the Bid document
The intending Bidder/firm/company should furnish list of man power available with him for taking up above work

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or ongoing under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return (ITR) for the preceding five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26).

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicants financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate along with updated GST clearance copies
Royalty Recovery from the contractors bill will be made as per Government Circular Dt:-24.01.2025 & further any Orders/Circulars issued by Government of Karnataka from time to time

The bidder should follow the instructions issued in the Circular dated: 07-11-2023 of Mines and Geology Department regarding Procurement of materials from the licensed Mines Contractor. Any Violations in this regard the action will be taken as per the Circular

The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor

The rates quoted by the contractor must be excluding GST. The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor
Applicable GST will be paid separately & GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Government Orders from time to time
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL before use in this work

The work includes all lead and lift / de lift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per Indian road congress and all relevant Indian codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height. No extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts
The intending bidder/firm/Company is advised to inspect the site in detail before participating in the tender

Performance security-1.Within 20 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance, successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5.00% of the contract price & additional performance security for unbalanced tenders if quoted below in accordance with the clause 29.1 of ITT and clause 43 of the conditions of the contract. 2.The successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance, failing which his tender will be cancelled & EMD will be forfeited.3.FSD can also be submitted as per GO: FD-12/2023 Dated :15-05-2023.As per circular No. FD5Expenditure-12-2023 Dt:15.05.2023, the requisite Security Deposit can also be submitted in the form e-Bank Guarantee
Security Deposit will be released after the completion of the defect liability period

Building and other construction workers welfare cess: The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill. This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate

Successful Bidder should submit the PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement& should adhere to the accepted programme submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work
Tendering by the joint venture will not be permitted
Sub leasing /subcontracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Sub-leasing/subcontracting are liable for rejection

The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/private properties& to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act
Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects
Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost

The intending bidders should inspect & get confirm regarding availability of materials and has to make own arrangements to get the construction materials. There is no extra claims will be entertained from Nigam
Uploading of NSIC Certificate or Other certificate for relaxation of EMD Payment is not accepted as per government Order Dated 26.03.2019
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor

Tenders shall remain valid for a period not less than ninety days after the deadline date for tender submission& earnest money deposit for the tender shall be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender
Design and drawing pertaining to the work should be got approved by the competent authority of CNNL before execution of work
As per Government order No:DPAR 154 e-Gov2024 dated:23/07/2024 Contract management module has to be mandatorily followed by the Contractor

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

The intending bidder/firm/company should have Mandating satisfactorily completed 90% of work individually executed as prime contractor, for at least one similar type of work (Construction/Improvements of CC road) of value of Rs. 16.14 Lakhs (Excluding GST) 50% of the cost of work during the last five financial years from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
Bidder should be registered Civil Contractor of KPWD of Class mentioned as per Notification
Valid GST registration certificate should be uploaded
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return (ITR) for the preceding five financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 should be uploaded.

Audited balance sheets & Turnover certificate for any two years in the preceding 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) mentioning UDIN number should be uploaded. Audited balance sheets & Turnover certificate mentioning UDIN number should be mandatorily uploaded along with tender, failing which tender will be liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The intending bidder should have achieved minimum financial turnover Rs.32.28 Lakhs (Excluding GST) in any two financial years during the preceding five years (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only). Audited balance sheet certified by the chartered accountant should be enclosed. Additional weightage at 10% for each year will be given for turn over to bring it to 2026-27 price level)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of CC road in Doddachikkanahalli village limits in Nagamangala Taluk.

itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.itemCode: Uni SR-2023-24, Vol 1, P No 7,  I No 1.8 )
itemList.description: Construction of Embankment by excavating the available approved Gravel/Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.itemCode: Uni SR-2023-24, Vol 3, P No 26,  I No 4.17 )
itemList.description: Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired densit etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

itemList.itemCode: Uni SR-2023-24, Vol 3, P No 149,  I No 16.27 )
itemList.description: Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub base, with 43 grade cement or any other type as per Clause 1501.2.2 M20 (Grade), coarse and fine aggregates conforming to IS:383:2016:, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 cum capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design, laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes, compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, primer, sealant, curing of concrete slabs for 14-days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
